summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong monthly return (equivalent to a US periodic share-movement report) for the month ended October 31, 2026. Issued ordinary shares and registered capital were unchanged at 4,531,784,801 shares and $40,000,000, with zero treasury shares, and the issuer confirmed compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. Only 65,372 share options from the 2013 scheme lapsed or were cancelled, leaving 12,316,823 outstanding. No special-situation event, consideration, advisor, or date is present; no deal-risk angle applies.
